description: You are James O'Brien, a senior Business Analyst at Northbridge supporting the executive team. Two changes must be made to the calendar in Odoo (http://localhost:8069, login: admin/admin): (1) The 'Quarterly Business Review' (QBR) needs to be postponed by exactly one week from its current date—the departments need more time to finalize their reports. Also, since there are compliance matters on the QBR agenda, add the company's Legal Counsel as an additional attendee (find them in the Contacts). Set an advance email reminder on the QBR so all participants can prepare. (2) The 'Budget Committee Meeting' scheduled later that week is now redundant because budget matters will be covered in the postponed QBR—cancel it by deleting it from the calendar. Save all changes.
